'''mrwaltdog Imperial Occupation (V)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[mrwaltdog]]
* '''Published:''' 5 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif|label=Imperial Occupation}}
* '''Strategy:''' Imperial Occupation
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 IOcc mrwaltdog DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Found I have the cards for this deck. Let me know what you think.

== Strategy ==

While I was making this deck I got all the cards I needed and had extra sapce and did not know what to do with it. That is the reason for some of the interesting cards in there. I am using Imperial Arrest Order because it gives Imperials with ability <3 +2 forfiet and the combo only gives them +1. Since most of my pilots only have 2 ability it works well. Plus Commander Praji can pull them out on the deck. When I played this deck I realized that the Rebel Base Occupation was just a wasted card. What cards should I put in instead of some of the random ones. I only own one Imperial walker and that is my only trample as well as Walker barrage also only own one AT-AT cannon currently(Never really bought many Hoth packs). I really did not see a reason to put in space if you know on then let me know. I have Prepare For A Surface Attack only because my force drains at hoth sites can't be cancle, I like that.
